title.ru: Past Perfect Continuous: предпрошедшее длительное время

summary.ru: Past Perfect Continuous (had been + -ing) показывает, что действие длилось в течение периода до другого события в прошлом, и часто объясняет причину или видимый результат.
summary.en: Past Perfect Continuous (had been + -ing) shows that an action was in progress for a period up to another past event, and it often explains a cause or a visible result.

body.ru: Past Perfect Continuous строится одинаково для всех лиц: had been + глагол с окончанием -ing. Отрицание — had not been, в вопросе had выходит на первое место.
body.en: Past Perfect Continuous has the same form for all persons: had been + the -ing form of the verb. The negative is had not been, and in questions had comes first.

examples: She had been working all day.
They had not been waiting long.
Had they been travelling all day?

heading.en: Meaning: duration up to a past moment

body.ru: Время показывает, что действие началось раньше другого прошлого события и продолжалось до него. Часто указана длительность: for, since, all morning, for hours. Само более позднее событие обычно стоит в Past Simple.
body.en: The tense shows that an action started before another past event and continued up to it. The length is often given with for, since, all morning or for hours. The later event is usually in Past Simple.

examples: He had been driving for hours before he stopped.
They had been living there for years before they moved.
We had been walking for an hour when it started to rain.

body.ru: Past Perfect Continuous часто объясняет, почему что-то было так в прошлом: он показывает процесс, который привёл к видимому результату. В главной части обычно Past Simple.
body.en: Past Perfect Continuous often explains why something was the case in the past: it shows the process that led to a visible result. The main clause is usually in Past Simple.

examples: Her hands were cold because she had been waiting outside.
The kitchen smelled wonderful because she had been baking.
The streets were empty because everyone had been watching the match.

heading.ru: Past Perfect Continuous и Past Perfect
heading.en: Past Perfect Continuous and Past Perfect

body.ru: Past Perfect Continuous подчёркивает процесс и длительность, а Past Perfect — завершённый результат или количество. Сравните, что важнее в предложении: как долго длилось действие или что оно дало.
body.en: Past Perfect Continuous emphasises the process and its duration, while Past Perfect emphasises the completed result or the number of times. Think about what matters in the sentence: how long the action lasted or what it produced.

examples: They had repaired the roof before the storm.
They had been repairing the roof all afternoon.
We had completed the course by June.
We had been studying for months.

body.ru: С этим временем часто идут for, since, all day, all morning, before и by the time. Глаголы состояния (know, believe, belong) обычно не ставят в Continuous — для них используют Past Perfect.
body.en: This tense often goes with for, since, all day, all morning, before and by the time. State verbs (know, believe, belong) are not usually used in the Continuous form — use Past Perfect instead.

examples: They had known each other for years.
How long had she been studying?
The children had been playing outside since lunchtime.

questions.sentence: When the rescue team arrived, the climbers ___ for two days.

translation.ru: Когда спасатели приехали, альпинисты шли уже два дня.

explanation.ru: Действие длилось до прошлого события, поэтому нужен Past Perfect Continuous: had been walking.
explanation.en: The action continued up to a past event, so Past Perfect Continuous is needed: had been walking.

questions.sentence: The children had been ___ in the garden before lunch.

translation.ru: Дети играли в саду до обеда.

explanation.ru: После had been нужна форма с -ing: had been playing.
explanation.en: After had been we need the -ing form: had been playing.

explanation.ru: После had been стоит форма с -ing: had been raining.
explanation.en: After had been we use the -ing form: had been raining.

explanation.ru: К моменту в прошлом действие уже длилось — Past Perfect Continuous.
explanation.en: At a past moment the action had already been going on, so Past Perfect Continuous is used.

questions.sentence: It was clear that they ___ for a long time.

translation.ru: Было ясно, что они ссорились уже долго.

explanation.ru: Длительность до прошлого момента передаёт Past Perfect Continuous.
explanation.en: Duration up to a past moment is expressed with Past Perfect Continuous.

explanation.ru: Длительный процесс объясняет видимый результат — Past Perfect Continuous.
explanation.en: The long process explains the visible result, so Past Perfect Continuous is used.

questions.sentence: Before he moved to London, he had been ___ in a small village.

explanation.en: The cause of the past visible result is Past Perfect Continuous.

explanation.ru: Действие длилось до прошлого события — Past Perfect Continuous.
explanation.en: The action continued up to a past event, so Past Perfect Continuous is used.

explanation.en: Past Perfect Continuous question: How long + had + subject + been + -ing.

explanation.en: The process that led to a past result is Past Perfect Continuous.

explanation.ru: Past Perfect Continuous: had been + -ing; all morning показывает длительность до момента в прошлом.
explanation.en: Past Perfect Continuous: had been + -ing; all morning shows duration up to a past moment.

translation.ru: Они ждали автобус с восьми часов.

explanation.en: Since marks the start of the action that continued up to a past moment.

explanation.ru: Had been running объясняет причину состояния was tired: процесс привёл к результату.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте значение Past Perfect Continuous и пример.
prompt.en: Match the meaning of Past Perfect Continuous with its example.

left.en: duration up to a past event

pairs.right: They had been waiting for two hours when the bus came.

left.en: the cause of a visible result

pairs.right: The ground was wet because it had been raining.

left.en: an action that started earlier and continued

pairs.right: She had been working there since 2019.
How long had you been waiting?

explanation.ru: Past Perfect Continuous называет длительность до прошлого события, объясняет причину результата и используется в вопросах о длительности.
explanation.en: Past Perfect Continuous names duration up to a past event, explains the cause of a result and is used in questions about duration.

prompt.en: Match the form with its example.

pairs.right: He had been studying all evening.
She had not been sleeping well.
Had they been travelling long?
We had been walking for three hours.

explanation.ru: Утверждение: had been + -ing; отрицание: had not been + -ing; вопрос начинается с Had; for вводит длительность.
explanation.en: Affirmative: had been + -ing; negative: had not been + -ing; questions begin with Had; for introduces duration.

prompt.en: Match the tense with its example.

left.ru: Past Perfect Continuous: процесс до прошлого момента
left.en: Past Perfect Continuous: a process up to a past moment

pairs.right: She had been writing letters all morning.
She had written three letters by noon.

left.en: Past Continuous: a process in the past

pairs.right: She was writing a letter when I came in.
She wrote a letter yesterday.

explanation.ru: Past Perfect Continuous показывает процесс до прошлого момента, Past Perfect — результат, Past Continuous — процесс в прошлом, Past Simple — законченное действие.
explanation.en: Past Perfect Continuous shows a process up to a past moment, Past Perfect a result, Past Continuous a past process, and Past Simple a finished action.

prompt.en: Match the marker with its example.

pairs.right: They had been waiting for forty minutes.
He had been living there since 2018.
I had been cleaning the house all morning.
She had been teaching for years before she retired.

explanation.ru: For называет длительность, since — начало, all morning подчёркивает период, before вводит более позднее событие.
explanation.en: For names duration, since the starting point, all morning emphasises the period, and before introduces the later event.

prompt.en: Match the meaning with its example.

pairs.right: He had been painting the fence all day.
He had painted the fence by lunchtime.
She was tired because she had been working.

left.en: a question about a process before an event

pairs.right: What had you been doing before I called?

explanation.ru: Past Perfect Continuous подчёркивает процесс и длительность, Past Perfect — результат; причина и вопросы о процессе также требуют Continuous.
explanation.en: Past Perfect Continuous emphasises the process and duration, Past Perfect the result; causes and questions about the process also need the Continuous form.
